title: 不对称有机催化
Asymmetric organocatalysis
deck: 从烯胺与亚胺离子活化，读到收率、er、ee 与非对映比。
From enamine/iminium activation to yield, er, ee and diastereomeric ratios.
about: 有机小分子可通过与底物暂时成键或非共价作用控制反应。这里以直接 aldol 和 Diels–Alder 为代表，逐项说明活化方式、底物范围与立体选择性。
Small organic molecules can control reactions through temporary covalent bonding or noncovalent interactions. Direct aldol and Diels–Alder examples connect activation, scope and stereoselectivity.
questions: 催化剂活化的是亲核体还是亲电体？
Does the catalyst activate a nucleophile or electrophile?
收率、ee、er 和 exo:endo 各描述什么？
What do yield, ee, er and exo:endo describe?
范围数据和放大实验能否对应到同一条件？
Do scope and scale-up records share conditions?

title: 脯氨酸催化的直接 aldol
Direct proline-catalyzed aldol
transformation: 丙酮 + 醛 → 手性 β-羟基酮
catalyst: L-脯氨酸；经烯胺形成提高亲核性。
conditions: 官方范围图：30 mol%、DMSO，6 个底物示例；逐个底物条件以原文为准。
Official scope figure: 30 mol%, DMSO, six examples; substrate-specific conditions follow the original paper.
limits: 范围端点不一定来自同一底物；er 不写成 ee。
Range endpoints may come from different substrates; er is not reported as ee.
locator: 诺奖科学背景印刷第 4 页式 2；原始论文及 SI。
Nobel background printed p. 4, equation 2; original paper/SI.

title: 亚胺离子活化的 Diels–Alder
Iminium-activated Diels–Alder
transformation: 肉桂醛 + 环戊二烯 → 手性环加成产物
catalyst: 论文催化剂 7，5 mol%；可逆形成亚胺离子。
Paper catalyst 7, 5 mol%; reversible iminium formation.
conditions: 表 1 条目 5：8 h；另有 50 mmol 制备规模实验。
Table 1 entry 5: 8 h; a separate 50 mmol preparation is reported.
outcome: 99% 收率；exo:endo 1.3:1；exo 为 93% ee。放大段落得 12 g。
99% yield; 1.3:1 exo:endo; exo 93% ee. Preparative paragraph reports 12 g.
limits: 总收率、非对映比和 exo ee 分别记录；实验室放大不等于工业生产。
Yield, diastereomeric ratio and exo ee remain separate; laboratory scale is not industrial output.
locator: JACS 表 1 条目 5；正文制备应用段落。

label: 脯氨酸用量
Proline loading
scope: 式 2 的 6 个范围示例；DMSO。
Equation 2, six scope examples; DMSO.

label: 官方范围图示例数
Examples in official scope figure
scope: 只统计式 2 所示范围，非完整文献总数。
Equation 2 only, not all literature examples.

label: aldol 收率范围
Aldol yield range
scope: 范围图不同底物，不能与最佳 er 拼成单一纪录。
Different substrates; not a combined optimum with best er.

label: aldol 对映体比例
Aldol enantiomeric ratio
scope: er，非 ee；与具体底物匹配。
er, not ee; match individual substrate.

label: Diels–Alder 催化剂 7 用量
Diels–Alder catalyst-7 loading
scope: 肉桂醛／环戊二烯；该条目 8 h。
Cinnamaldehyde/cyclopentadiene; 8 h.

label: Diels–Alder 总收率
Diels–Alder total yield
scope: exo:endo 为 1.3:1，不是单一非对映体收率。
exo:endo 1.3:1; not single-diastereomer yield.

label: exo 产物对映体过量
Exo product enantiomeric excess
scope: 仅 exo 组分；不与 endo 混为总体 ee。
Exo fraction only; not a pooled endo/exo ee.

label: 实验室制备投料规模
Laboratory preparative scale
scope: 与表 1 筛选条目分开记录。
Separate preparative run from screening entry.

label: 制备实验产物质量
Preparative product mass
scope: 原文同时报告 99% 收率与 exo 93% ee，非工厂产量。
Also reports 99% yield/exo 93% ee; not factory output.

title: 烯胺与亚胺离子
Enamines and iminium ions
body: 烯胺形成可提高羰基 α 位的亲核性；不饱和亚胺离子形成可增强亲电反应性。这是活化模式说明，具体中间体和过渡态证据仍以原文研究为准。
Enamine formation increases α-carbon nucleophilicity, while unsaturated iminium formation enhances electrophilic reactivity. Specific intermediate/transition-state evidence remains source-dependent.

title: 立体选择性要分层阅读
Separate stereochemical metrics
body: ee = |R−S|/(R+S)×100%，er 是两对映体的比例；非对映体比例另用 dr 或 exo:endo。Diels–Alder 例的 exo 93% ee 与 1.3:1 非对映比可以同时成立。
ee is |R−S|/(R+S)×100%, er is an enantiomer ratio, and diastereomers need dr or exo:endo. Exo 93% ee and a 1.3:1 diastereomeric ratio can coexist.

title: 从反应方法到过程评价
From method to process assessment
body: 催化剂摩尔分数、溶剂、分离步骤和底物范围都会影响实用性。无金属有机催化不自动代表更低的过程能耗、溶剂消耗或废物量。
Loading, solvent, workup and scope affect practical use. Metal-free organocatalysis alone does not establish lower energy, solvent use or waste.

marketNote: 本次检索未收录直接对应、可核验的预测市场；本专题展示文献中的实验与项目资料。
This search added no directly matching verified forecast contracts; this topic presents literature experiments and project records.

title: 可见光光氧化还原合成
Visible-light photoredox synthesis
deck: 自由基生成、手性控制与光反应条件分别核对。
Inspect radical generation, stereocontrol and illumination conditions separately.
about: 光激发可改变催化剂的单电子转移能力，有机催化则可提供底物活化与手性环境。本专题比较 Ru／胺双催化与有机染料路线，保留各自条件。
Photoexcitation changes single-electron-transfer capability while organocatalysts activate substrates and provide stereocontrol. Ru/amine and organic-dye routes retain their distinct conditions.
questions: 光催化剂和有机催化剂分别承担什么作用？
What roles do the photo- and organocatalysts play?
光源功率、波长、几何和反应温度是否同时记录？
Are power, spectrum, geometry and temperature documented?
收率与 ee 是否来自同一底物和条件？
Do yield and ee refer to the same substrate and conditions?

title: 双催化醛 α-烷基化
Dual-catalytic aldehyde α-alkylation
transformation: 辛醛 + 溴代丙二酸二乙酯 → α-取代醛
catalyst: Ru(bpy)₃Cl₂ 0.5 mol% + 手性有机催化剂 6 20 mol%。
conditions: DMF、2,6-lutidine、23 °C、15 W 荧光灯；表 1 通用图示。
DMF, 2,6-lutidine, 23 °C, 15 W fluorescent lamp; Table 1 conditions.
outcome: 同一条目 1：93% 收率、90% ee。
limits: 灯泡瓦数不等于有效照射强度；其他底物条目的例外催化剂用量不被覆盖。
Lamp wattage is not irradiance; exceptions in other substrate entries are not overwritten.
locator: Science 表 1 条目 1、催化剂组合图及脚注。
Science Table 1 entry 1, catalyst box and footnotes.

title: 染料介导的无过渡金属 α-烷基化
Dye-mediated transition-metal-free α-alkylation
transformation: 醛 + 烷基化试剂 → 对映富集 α-烷基化产物
Aldehyde + alkylating reagent → enantioenriched α-alkylated product
catalyst: Rose Bengal + 咪唑烷酮有机催化剂；另有亲电助催化剂。
Rose Bengal + imidazolidinone, with an electrophilic cocatalyst.
conditions: 可见光体系；完整溶剂、剂量和底物条件见原文及 SI。
Visible-light system; exact solvent, dose and substrate conditions follow the paper/SI.
outcome: 原文报告直接对映选择性 α-烷基化；本页不填入未逐项核对的产率。
The source reports direct enantioselective α-alkylation; unverified individual yields are not inserted.
limits: 不把 Ru 体系数据移植至染料体系；无过渡金属不是全流程环境评价。
Ru-system data are not transferred; transition-metal-free is not a lifecycle assessment.
locator: Green Chemistry 正文与补充材料。

label: Ru 光催化剂用量
Ru photocatalyst loading
scope: 与 20 mol% 有机催化剂协同；不是无金属体系。
Combined with 20 mol% organocatalyst; not metal-free.

label: 有机催化剂用量
Organocatalyst loading
scope: 条目 1；其他条目如有脚注例外需另查。
Entry 1; exceptions require footnote review.

label: 荧光灯额定功率
Fluorescent-lamp rated power
scope: 灯泡功率，非光通量、光子通量或量子产率。
Lamp rating, not flux or quantum yield.

label: 反应温度
Reaction temperature
scope: DMF、荧光灯体系；不推广到所有光反应。
DMF/fluorescent-lamp system, not all photoreactions.

label: 辛醛 α-烷基化收率
Octanal α-alkylation yield
scope: 溴代丙二酸二乙酯体系；与相邻行 ee 同一条目。
Diethyl bromomalonate system; same entry as the adjacent ee.

label: 辛醛 α-烷基化 ee
Octanal α-alkylation ee
scope: 对应 93% 收率条目；不是全部底物平均值。
Same entry as 93% yield; not a scope average.

title: 单电子转移与两电子反应
Single-electron and two-electron chemistry
body: 自由基生成提供不同的成键路径，但反应是否成功仍取决于电子转移、催化循环和底物匹配。机理图表示研究提出的过程，不能仅凭高产率证明每个中间体。
Radical generation enables different bond-forming paths, but electron transfer, turnover and substrate matching still matter. A proposed mechanism is not established solely by high yield.

title: 光反应的可比条件
Comparable photochemical conditions
body: 波长分布、灯到样品距离、容器、搅拌、溶液吸收和温度都影响结果。只报告 15 W 灯泡不能完整重现有效光剂量，也不能计算量子产率。
Spectrum, distance, vessel, mixing, absorption and temperature influence results. A 15 W rating does not reproduce absorbed light dose or determine quantum yield.

title: 绿色主张要核算全流程
Assess the whole process
body: 可见光或无过渡金属是技术属性。环境比较还需溶剂、助试剂、分离、能源和产物量的共同口径。
Visible-light and transition-metal-free describe methods; environmental comparisons also need solvent, reagents, isolation, energy and product-scale accounting.

title: 点击与生物正交化学
Click & bioorthogonal chemistry
deck: 从 CuAAC 的区域选择性，到无铜连接与成像读出。
From CuAAC regioselectivity to copper-free ligation and imaging readouts.
about: 点击化学强调可靠的分子连接，生物正交还要求反应在复杂生物环境中尽量避免干扰原有过程。这里分别展示固相、溶液 CuAAC 与应变促进路线。

Click chemistry emphasizes reliable molecular connection, while bioorthogonality adds compatibility with complex biological environments. Solid-phase/solution CuAAC and strain-promoted routes are distinguished.
questions: 连接的是哪些官能团，形成哪种区域异构体？
Which functional groups connect and which regioisomer forms?
催化剂、介质和生物相容性怎样对应？
How do catalyst, medium and biological compatibility relate?
检测信号是否能直接代表化学转化？
Does the detection signal directly measure chemical conversion?

title: 固相 CuAAC 肽连接
Solid-phase CuAAC peptide ligation
transformation: 树脂连接末端炔 + 有机叠氮 → 1,4-取代三唑
Resin-bound terminal alkyne + organic azide → 1,4-substituted triazole
catalyst: Cu(I) 催化；极性固相载体。
Cu(I) catalysis on a polar solid support.
conditions: 官方图 6a：碱、THF、25 °C；具体试剂量见原研究。
Official Figure 6a: base, THF, 25 °C; amounts follow the original study.
outcome: 构建肽骨架或侧链三唑，研究多类叠氮底物。
Constructs peptide backbone/side-chain triazoles across azide classes.
limits: 不把树脂负载、区域选择性和分离收率混为一项数值。
Resin loading, regioselectivity and isolated yield remain separate.
locator: JOC 原研究；诺奖科学背景图 6a。
JOC original study; Nobel background Figure 6a.

title: 溶液中原位生成 Cu(I) 的连接
Solution ligation with in-situ Cu(I)
transformation: 有机叠氮 + 末端炔 → 1,4-二取代 1,2,3-三唑
catalyst: CuSO₄·5H₂O／抗坏血酸钠，原位形成 Cu(I)。
outcome: 选择性形成所示 1,4-取代产物；本页不将“高收率”改写成统一百分比。
Selective 1,4-product formation; qualitative high yield is not assigned an invented percentage.
limits: 水相有机合成与活细胞相容性不是同一要求。
Aqueous synthesis and live-cell compatibility impose different requirements.
locator: 诺奖科学背景印刷第 7 页图 6b。

title: 环张力促进的生物正交连接
Strain-promoted bioorthogonal ligation
transformation: 环辛炔类探针 + 叠氮标记生物分子 → 共价连接产物
Cyclooctyne probe + azide-labelled biomolecule → covalent conjugate
catalyst: 环张力驱动；无需铜催化剂。
Ring strain drives reaction; no copper catalyst.
conditions: 2004 生理条件化学；2007 活体系成像是后续独立工作。
Physiological-condition chemistry in 2004; live-system imaging in 2007 is separate follow-up.
outcome: 展示选择性连接与成像应用，不把荧光读出当作分离收率。
Selective ligation and imaging are shown without treating fluorescence as isolated yield.
limits: 反应速率、背景和探针相容性依赖具体结构与环境。
Rate, background and compatibility depend on probe and environment.

label: 早期固相 CuAAC 收率范围
Early solid-phase CuAAC yield range
period: 2001 会议工作；2022 官方汇总
scope: 官方印刷第 6 页；不冒充 2002 全底物统一结果。
Printed p. 6; not a universal 2002 scope result.

label: 固相 CuAAC 图示温度
Solid-phase CuAAC illustrated temperature
scope: Cu(I)、碱、THF；其余参数以原研究为准。
Cu(I), base, THF; remaining details in original study.

label: 溶液 CuAAC 图示温度
Solution CuAAC illustrated temperature
scope: CuSO₄／抗坏血酸钠；水／叔丁醇。
CuSO₄/ascorbate; water/tert-butanol.

title: 区域选择性与原子连接
Regioselectivity and connectivity
body: 末端炔与有机叠氮可形成三唑。CuAAC 选择性形成 1,4-取代产物；非催化热反应与不同金属体系可能有不同的区域选择性。
Terminal alkynes and azides form triazoles. CuAAC favors the 1,4-product, whereas uncatalyzed thermal or other metal systems can differ.

title: 生物正交是额外要求
Bioorthogonality adds requirements
body: 在有机溶剂中高收率连接，并不自动满足细胞中的速率、选择性和相容性。无铜路线仍须检查探针结构、非特异背景与实际反应环境。
High-yield organic-solvent ligation does not automatically meet cellular rate, selectivity or compatibility requirements. Copper-free probes still need background and context checks.

title: 从标记到读数
From labelling to readout
body: 标记反应与显影过程涉及浓度、孵育、清洗、定位及仪器设置。荧光强度的变化需要适当对照，不能未经校准就称为分离产率。
Labelling/readout depends on concentration, incubation, washing, localization and instruments. Fluorescence changes need controls and are not uncalibrated isolated yields.

marketNote: 本次检索未收录直接对应、可核验的预测市场；本专题展示文献中的实验与项目资料。
This search added no directly matching verified forecast contracts; this topic presents literature experiments and project records.

title: PET 解聚与酶催化循环
PET depolymerization & enzymatic recycling
deck: 把酯键水解、单体回收、再聚合和工厂处理能力分别计量。
Measure ester hydrolysis, monomer recovery, repolymerization and plant throughput separately.
about: PET 属于聚酯，酶催化可以断裂其酯键并回收单体。材料结晶度、预处理和传质影响反应，实验解聚与商品级单体分离、再聚合仍是不同环节。

PET is a polyester whose ester bonds can be hydrolyzed enzymatically. Crystallinity, pretreatment and transport affect reaction; laboratory depolymerization, commercial monomer separation and repolymerization are distinct steps.
questions: 底物是薄片、热成型产品还是经处理的瓶体？
Is the feed a film, thermoformed product or treated bottle?
解聚、单体分离和再聚合各自的物料衡算是什么？
What are the mass balances for depolymerization, separation and repolymerization?
工厂数据是设计能力、进料量还是实际产品量？
Is a plant figure design capacity, feed or measured output?

title: 工程化水解酶回收 PET 单体
Engineered hydrolase recovers PET monomers
transformation: PET 酯键水解 → 对苯二甲酸类产物与乙二醇
PET ester hydrolysis → terephthalate and ethylene glycol
catalyst: 2020 年研究的工程化 PET 水解酶。
Engineered PET hydrolase from the 2020 study.
conditions: 摘要：200 g PET/kg 悬浮液，3 mg 酶/g PET，10 h；完整预处理、pH 与温度见原文。
Abstract: 200 g PET/kg suspension, 3 mg enzyme/g PET, 10 h; full pretreatment, pH and temperature follow the paper.
outcome: 至少 90% 解聚；16.7 g 对苯二甲酸类产物·L⁻¹·h⁻¹；展示再聚合。
At least 90% depolymerization; 16.7 g terephthalate·L⁻¹·h⁻¹, with repolymerization.
limits: 解聚率、单体回收率与再聚合总收率不同；不适用于所有塑料。
Depolymerization, monomer recovery and overall repolymerization yield differ; not all plastics qualify.
locator: Nature 2020 原文摘要与实验部分。

title: FAST-PETase 与不同 PET 形态
FAST-PETase across PET forms
transformation: 消费后 PET → 可回收单体；再合成 PET
Post-consumer PET → recoverable monomers and resynthesized PET
catalyst: 机器学习辅助改造的 FAST-PETase。
conditions: 51 种未处理热成型产品：一周内；水瓶无定形部分与热处理整瓶另在 50 °C 下研究。
51 untreated thermoformed products: within a week; bottle amorphous regions and pretreated whole bottles separately at 50 °C.
outcome: 所测热成型产品近乎完全解聚，并展示回收单体后的闭环。
Near-complete depolymerization of tested thermoformed products and a recovered-monomer loop.
limits: 热成型样品与高结晶瓶体、热预处理整瓶不能混为相同底物条件。
Thermoformed material, crystalline bottles and pretreated whole bottles are distinct conditions.

label: PET 解聚率与反应时间
PET depolymerization and time
scope: 对应下列投料与酶用量；不是环境降解半衰期。
At the stated loading/enzyme dose; not environmental half-life.

label: 对苯二甲酸类产物生产率
Terephthalate productivity
scope: 以对苯二甲酸类产物质量计，非总单体或净循环收益。
Terephthalate mass, not total monomer or net circular benefit.

label: 悬浮液 PET 投料
PET loading in suspension
scope: 分母为悬浮液质量，不擅自换成 g/L。
Per kg suspension, not silently converted to g/L.

label: 酶质量用量
Enzyme mass loading
scope: 以 PET 质量为分母，不是催化剂 mol%。
Per mass of PET, not catalyst mol%.

label: 热成型消费后样品数
Post-consumer thermoformed products
scope: 所测未处理热成型产品，一周内近乎完全解聚。
Tested untreated thermoformed products, near-complete within one week.

label: 水瓶相关试验温度
Bottle-experiment temperature
scope: 未处理无定形部分与热处理整瓶分别研究，非任意未处理整瓶。
Amorphous regions and thermally pretreated whole bottles separately; not any untreated bottle.

label: 工厂设计废料处理能力
Plant design waste-processing capacity
scope: 满负荷项目目标；后续报告记录 2024-12 暂停建设，不推断当前状态。
Full-operation target; later report records December 2024 suspension, without inferring current status.

title: 酯键水解与塑料类别
Ester hydrolysis and polymer class
body: PET 水解涉及酯键断裂，不是直接切断任意聚合物的碳—碳主链。PET 研究不能推广到聚乙烯、聚丙烯等不同化学结构的塑料。
PET hydrolysis cleaves ester bonds rather than arbitrary C–C polymer backbones; results do not automatically extend to polyethylene or polypropylene.

title: 形态与预处理影响反应
Morphology and pretreatment
body: 结晶度、比表面积、粒径和热处理影响酶与聚合物接触。不同形态的数据应保留预处理条件，避免把易解聚薄片结果用作所有水瓶的表现。
Crystallinity, area, size and heat treatment affect enzyme–polymer contact. Preserve pretreatment so accessible films do not stand in for all bottles.

title: 闭环不只是一项高转化率
A loop needs more than high conversion
body: 闭环还需回收纯度、损失、再聚合质量和能源物料核算。论文与项目历史分别记录；早期 50 kt/年目标不写成已实现的稳定吞吐量。
A loop also needs purity, losses, repolymerized quality and resource accounting. Papers and project history remain separate; an early 50 kt/year target is not measured steady throughput.

marketNote: 本次检索未收录直接对应、可核验的预测市场；本专题展示文献中的实验与项目资料。
